scope: Existing pooled-response sources Ahmad 2018, Nath 2021, Singh 2026; no new literature sweep or acquisition

source_reviews.quote:
The previous 
trained model using the RF model (Singh et al., 2022) and 
validated in Belpada was used in the current study (Table 2).
source_reviews.decision: Explicit model reuse. Already represented in importance-tree lineage; now aligned in EV model-use metadata. Do not transfer this model lineage to pH thresholds automatically.

source_reviews.quote:
The suitable scores 
(ranks/classes) to diﬀerent ranges of each variable under each criterion 
were decided based on the relevant available literature, discussion with 
peers, and knowledge of the domain experts.
source_reviews.decision: Classes are literature/expert informed, not independent empirical calibration. No specific common threshold origin established for the existing pools.
